limitations: Single seed nominal recorded actions and overlapping windows; no training/control/planning.
Corrections inject real-history information diagnostically and are not a deployable solution.
Train PCA/covariance describe linear distribution proxies, not a proven nonlinear latent manifold.
Empirical decoder sensitivity ratio depends on latent/output units, not Jacobian spectral norm.
Pearson correlations and observation/latent drift association do not identify causality.

measured_assessment.local_consistency: Local scale-aware latent RMSE 0.109955 versus identity 0.192827 (42.98% lower), cosine 0.996376. Accuracy is useful but not nearly exact: mean local residual L2 0.119334 versus mean encoder-reference movement 0.150880. These are means, not a per-sample ratio. High cosine does not establish increment consistency.
measured_assessment.composition: Autonomous latent RMSE grows to 0.749678 and mean L2 to 0.809398 at H50. Diagnostic correction intervals 1/5/10/25/never give H50 observation RMSE 0.046164/0.076160/0.109667/0.237967/0.510667 on the identical 26122-window cohort. C50 equals never, with no endpoint correction. Shorter intervals monotonically reduce endpoint error, but inject real-history information and are not a deployable solution.
measured_assessment.distribution_drift: Train PCA retains 13 components and 95.1493% variance. Predicted regularized Mahalanobis RMS grows 0.948641 to 3.441289 versus reference 0.810252 to 0.839478; PCA residual L2 grows 0.234264 to 0.535272 versus reference 0.227364 to 0.233595. Standardized RMS changes much less, 0.818582 to 0.973672 versus reference 0.828419 to 0.860376. Evidence supports departure along low-variance/out-of-principal-subspace directions, not a proof of leaving a nonlinear manifold or numerical explosion.
measured_assessment.decoder_geometry: Mean empirical sensitivity ratio increases 0.211348 to 1.198374 (median 0.171558 to 1.161877). Mean decoded normalized L2 deviation increases 0.030707 to 1.051632 while raw latent L2 increases 0.119334 to 0.809398. Direction-dependent decoding sensitivity accompanies drift, but coordinate-dependent ratios cannot prove a Decoder-only root cause or a Jacobian spectral bound. Current reconstruction remains 0.038286.
measured_assessment.correlations: Initial local residual has Pearson correlation with H5/10/25/50 latent L2 of 0.719460/0.616529/0.541382/0.493170; with H50 observation error 0.443245 and horizontal-velocity error 0.414008. H50 horizontal error correlates with predicted Mahalanobis/PCA residual at 0.635503/0.656474 and paired predicted-minus-reference excess at 0.446859/0.278058. Reference scores are themselves correlated with velocity error; state/action composition and overlapping windows confound causal interpretation.
measured_assessment.region_findings: H50 observation RMSE is 0.243606/0.264566/0.283025/0.567705 for distance <0.1/0.1-0.2/0.2-0.5/>=0.5; corresponding C1 values 0.008890/0.025594/0.028687/0.050818. Small/medium/large PI: 0.211972/0.400007/0.737618, and small/medium/large initial executed-action norm: 0.176569/0.536654/0.650815. All groups improve under C1. The <0.1 group has only 80 H50 windows. H50 Train-PCA residual tertile bins place all predictions in the large group, so those bins cannot estimate a within-horizon graded trend.
measured_assessment.most_supported_mechanism: Non-negligible encoder-transition local inconsistency compounded during repeated autonomous propagation, with drift into low-variance/out-of-principal-subspace coordinates and increasing empirical Decoder sensitivity. This is strongest for composition/drift (case A-like), with a case B local-consistency caveat and case C decoding-geometry association. Corrections recover accuracy, so case D is not supported. No uniquely identified module-level causal root cause.
measured_assessment.deterministic_formulation: Still worth a controlled repair experiment; this audit does not establish that stochastic/RSSM structure is necessary.
measured_assessment.single_recommended_next_experiment: A separately authorized, objective-matched encoder-transition consistency-loss control: keep the observation K10 objective, initialization, architecture, optimizer and data protocol unchanged, and test whether the added explicit consistency constraint reduces local discrepancy and H50 composition drift. This audit does not execute that experiment.
